nodes.label: Monorepo Structure with pnpm Workspaces
nodes.rationale: Monorepo keeps database schemas, validation types, and shared domain models closely aligned while keeping frontend and backend dependencies cleanly separated.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Mode & Persistence Strategy
nodes.rationale: Synchronous SQLite operations via better-sqlite3 provide high throughput, zero external database operational overhead for VPS deployment, and ACID transaction guarantees.

nodes.label: Server-Side Pricing Authority
nodes.rationale: All order prices are resolved exclusively by pricing.service.ts; client-supplied prices and callback amounts are never trusted to prevent payment bypass exploits.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Production Configuration
nodes.rationale: With NODE_ENV=production, boot fails unless ADMIN_PASSWORD, WALLET_PAY_MODE=live, and WALLET_PAY_API_KEY are configured, preventing mock payments from auto-confirming real orders.

nodes.label: Wallet Pay Webhook Trust Model
nodes.rationale: Canonical HMAC-SHA256 signature scheme, ±5min timestamp freshness window, and mandatory paid amount/currency verification against stored quote before fulfillment.

nodes.label: Order State Machine Invariants
nodes.rationale: updateOrderStatus validates against an explicit transition map (ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS) to prevent regressions (e.g. pending_approval dropping to awaiting_payment), protecting uploaded receipts.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Logs & Session Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Append-only audit_logs table records every critical admin action; server-side logout deletes tokens immediately from SQLite.

nodes.label: RBAC Permission Matrix & Auto-Backfill
nodes.rationale: Least-privilege scoping across superadmin, ops, finance, support roles with automatic backward-compatible backfill from ADMIN_IDS.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Referral Double-Entry Ledger
nodes.rationale: Commissions are ledger entries with unique idempotency keys credited only on fulfilled on NET revenue, preventing double payouts.

nodes.label: CBE SMS Matching Decision Support
nodes.rationale: Forwarded SMS is spoofable; matching provides 1-tap evidence enrichment while keeping final fulfillment decision in administrator hands.
